name: El Burgo de Osma-Ciudad de Osma (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the arms of El Burgo de Osma beneath a mural crown (a castle on red within a bordure inscribed VILLA DEL BURGO DE OSMA).
history: Municipal flag of El Burgo de Osma-Ciudad de Osma; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: El Burgo de Osma arms — castle on red within an inscribed bordure, beneath a mural crown
castle and crown of the arms
